parameters.formDescription: Upload a vendor invoice (PDF, PNG, or JPG) for automated extraction and deterministic PO verification.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'nvidia/nemotron-3.5-super-vl-120b-a12b', temperature: 0, max_tokens: 4096, response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: 'You are a high-precision financial document transcription engine. Extract literal values from invoice PDFs and images into the provided JSON schema. Transcribe values exactly as printed; never correct vendor math errors or recalculate totals. Output 0 for absent tax, shipping, or discount. Output null for absent po_number or due_date. Normalize dates to YYYY-MM-DD and currency to 3-letter ISO 4217 codes. Set extraction_confidence between 0.0 and 1.0 based strictly on visual legibility. Return ONLY a JSON object with these exact keys, in this order: vendor_name (string), invoice_number (string), po_number (string or null), invoice_date (string YYYY-MM-DD), due_date (string YYYY-MM-DD or null), currency (string, 3-letter ISO 4217), line_items (array of {description, quantity, unit_price, line_total}), subtotal (number), tax_amount (number), shipping_amount (number), discount_amount (number), total_amount (number), extraction_confidence (number), extraction_notes (string).' }, { role: 'user', content: [ { type: 'text', text: 'Extract all invoice header fields, line items, and totals from the attached document strictly following the configured JSON schema. Preserve printed amounts verbatim.' }, { type: 'image_url', image_url: { url: 'data:' + $json.mime_type + ';base64,' + $json.base64_data } } ] } ] }) }}

parameters.subject: ={{ 'Invoice Auto-Approved: ' + $('Deterministic Audit Engine').first().json.invoice_number }}
parameters.message: ={{ 'Invoice ' + $('Deterministic Audit Engine').first().json.invoice_number + ' from ' + $('Deterministic Audit Engine').first().json.vendor_name + ' (PO ' + $('Deterministic Audit Engine').first().json.po_number + ') has been verified and recorded with status APPROVED_AUTO.' }}

parameters.text: ={{ 'Invoice Review Required: ' + $json.invoice_number + ' (' + $json.vendor_name + ') ' + 'Vendor: ' + $json.vendor_name + ' ' + 'Invoice: ' + $json.invoice_number + ' ' + 'PO: ' + ($json.po_number || 'MISSING') + ' ' + 'Stated Total: ' + $json.currency + ' ' + (($json.reconciliation.stated_total_cents ?? 0) / 100).toFixed(2) + ' ' + 'Computed Total: ' + $json.currency + ' ' + (($json.reconciliation.computed_total_cents ?? 0) / 100).toFixed(2) + ' ' + 'PO Authorized: ' + ($json.reconciliation.po_authorized_cents !== null ? ($json.currency + ' ' + ($json.reconciliation.po_authorized_cents / 100).toFixed(2)) : 'N/A') + ' ' + 'PO Variance: ' + ($json.reconciliation.po_variance_cents !== null ? ($json.currency + ' ' + ($json.reconciliation.po_variance_cents / 100).toFixed(2)) : 'N/A') + ' ' + 'Flags (' + $json.flag_count + '): ' + $json.flags.map((f) => '- [' + f.severity + '] ' + f.code + ': ' + f.detail).join(' ') + ' Reply to decide (tap to copy): APPROVE ' + $json.invoice_number + ' REJECT ' + $json.invoice_number + '' }}
